gpt.rationale: Fear suits the flustered opening and anger fits her quiet offense, but repeated fear on neutral/self-intro lines and broad happiness where she should show only small, restrained warmth make the sequence only partly fit this introverted character.

claude.rationale: Sprites consistently reflect an introverted personality—fear/hesitation dominate early exchanges, happiness emerges only in safe moments of gratitude, and emotional restraint is maintained throughout; minor misalignment occurs with the 'happiness' sprite during 'You don't have to—' (which reads as mild protest rather than genuine warmth) and 'surprise' at 'You know already?' (which fits the line but slightly overstates her typical reserved reaction).
